title: Ay bhai hussaina
body:
shabbir se milne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ko ziyarat ke liye laayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
saumpi thi amanat jo mujhe aap ne bhaiya
wo pyari sakina
afsos usay shaam may chod aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya mere akbar ki qasam sabr kiya hai
shikwa nahi lab par
raahon may har ek gaam pe dukh paayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se mai tumhe chod ke maqtal se gayi hoo
kya guzri hai tum par
kuch to kaho sadqe gayi maajayi ay zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange thi aur haath bhi gardan se bandhe thay
jis basti se guzri
paigham tera sab ko suna aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pa teri dekh ye behosh pade hai
kis kis ko bataun
jis jis ko aseeri se chuda laayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra jo ye poochegi kahan hai mera asghar
mai us se kahun kya
kehdungi tere paas sula aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauqeer laraz jaata hai shabbir ka rauza
ye aaj bhi sun kar
shabbir se milne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
author: Tauqeer Zaidi
